title: List dreams
summary: List memory-consolidation dream jobs, newest first. Archived dreams are excluded unless include_archived=true is passed. statuses (repeatable) filters by lifecycle state; created_at[gt] / created_at[lt] bound the created window; limit and page drive cursor pagination.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Optional. Pass true to include archived dreams. Any other non-boolean value is a 400.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Optional. Repeat to filter by lifecycle state: pending, running, completed, failed, canceled. statuses[] is accepted as the SDK spelling.

parameters.name: created_at[gt]
parameters.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp; only dreams created strictly after it are returned.

parameters.name: created_at[lt]
parameters.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp; only dreams created strictly before it are returned.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional opaque continuation cursor from a previous response's next_page.

response.name: data
response.description: Dream resources with status, inputs, outputs, session_id, usage, and lifecycle timestamps.

response.name: next_page
response.description: Continuation cursor for the next page, or null when the list is exhausted.

title: Create dream
summary: Create and start a memory-consolidation dream. inputs must name exactly one memory_store entry and one sessions entry with 1-100 unique session ids. The pipeline runs in an internal session (session_id); output_behavior defaults to create_new, which seeds a new store as a copy of the input. update_existing writes into the input store and conflicts while another such dream on the same store is still active.

parameters.name: inputs
parameters.description: Exactly one {type:'memory_store', memory_store_id} and one {type:'sessions', session_ids} entry.

parameters.name: instructions
parameters.description: Optional consolidation guidance, 1-4096 characters when supplied.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional model id, or {id, speed:'standard'}. Resolution order: request model, then the dreams.model runtime setting, then the workspace default model.

parameters.name: output_behavior
parameters.description: Optional. {type:'create_new'} (default) or {type:'update_existing', memory_store_id} targeting the input store.

response.name: dream
response.description: The created dream (HTTP 201). status is running once the pipeline session exists, or failed with error populated if startup could not run.

title: Retrieve dream
summary: Retrieve one dream by id. Reads reconcile status from the pipeline session before projecting, so a finished run reports its real state. Archived dreams remain retrievable.

response.name: dream
response.description: The dream resource: status, inputs, outputs (the output memory store once recorded), session_id for the pipeline session, usage counters, error, and lifecycle timestamps.

title: Cancel dream
summary: Cancel a pending or running dream: the dream flips to canceled, the pipeline session is interrupted and archived, and the output store keeps whatever it already holds. Cancel on a terminal dream is a 400.

title: Archive dream
summary: Archive a terminal dream (completed, failed, or canceled). Archiving a pending or running dream is a 400 — cancel it first. The call is idempotent for an already archived dream.

response.name: dream
response.description: The archived dream, with archived_at set.
